title: Pyramids of Meroë (royal cemeteries of Kush)
note: Seed guidance inbox item. Kushite royal pyramids, UNESCO WHC 1336 (Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe); under-recorded region; follow the pyramid-tomb thread from Giza to Nubia. Needs model (importance likely 3–4).

title: Wadi al-Jarf, harbour of Khufu on the Red Sea
note: Oldest known Egyptian port, excavated since 2011 by Tallet and Marouard (Sorbonne/IFAO); departure point for Sinai copper and turquoise expeditions; link to Tell Ras Budran (JARCE 52, 2017). Coordinates still to be sourced.

title: Logbook of Merer (Wadi al-Jarf papyri A and B)
note: Oldest inscribed papyrus archive yet found in Egypt (2013); published by Tallet, MIFAO 136 (2017) with English translation; Year 26 of Khufu; Tura–Giza stone shipping; held in Egyptian collections (verify current holder).

title: Heit el-Ghurab, settlement of the Giza pyramid builders
note: AERA excavations since 1988 (Lehner); >7 ha, galleries, bakeries, silos, Royal Administrative Building; demolished after Menkaure. Non-elite lives of the workforce; workers' cemetery and diet studies in AERA bibliography.

title: Ankhhaf, vizier and director of works under Khufu
note: Khufu's half-brother, in charge of Ro-She Khufu per the Merer logbook (Tallet 2017); his bust is in the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston (verify).

title: Step Pyramid of Djoser, Saqqara
note: First monumental stone building and first pyramid (UNESCO WHC 86); Djoser accession 2691–2625 BCE by radiocarbon (Bronk Ramsey et al. 2010) vs 2667 BCE (Shaw). Needs model.
